test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select 'No substitution required".

The old lady was unable to climb stairs because her legs **__is aching constantly__** since morning.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contains a tense inconsistency. The phrase "**her legs is aching**" uses the incorrect verb form "is" instead of the plural verb "have."
 
• Since the subject "**legs**" is plural, the verb should match it in number.
 
• Additionally, the phrase "**since morning**" indicates an ongoing action starting from the past, which requires the present perfect continuous tense.
 
• The correct phrase is "**her legs have been aching constantly**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The old lady was unable to climb stairs because her legs have been aching constantly since morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "is been aching constantly" – This is grammatically incorrect because "is been" is not a valid construction in English.
 
• **Option 3:** "Had been aches constantly" – This is incorrect because "had been" should be followed by the -ing form of the verb, not the base form.
 
• **Option 4:** "No substitution required" – This is incorrect because the original sentence contains grammatical errors.
 
• **Option 2:** "have been aching constantly" is the correct choice because it ensures subject-verb agreement and the proper tense usage.
